Once there was a little girl called Lucy. She was very independent. She liked to do everything by herself.

One day Lucy was in the garden. She started to jump and hop around. She was having lots of fun, springing around in the grass.

Next she heard the telephone ringing. She was very excited. She had never heard a telephone before. She wanted to see who was on the phone.

She ran into the house and saw her Mum talking into the phone. Lucy wanted to talk to the person on the phone too. She was very independent and wanted to do it all by herself.

She picked up the telephone and listened to the voice on the other end. Even though she couldn't understand the person on the phone, she felt very proud that she had answered the telephone all by herself.

Once upon a time there was a young boy who was very proud of his family. Every morning he would go down to the market to get a bag of rice for his family. He would go home, proud of himself for being able to get the rice for his family.

One day the boy went to the market, but the shopkeeper would not permit him to buy the rice. The shopkeeper said he was too young and could not buy it himself. The boy begged and pleaded with the shopkeeper, but he refused to let him buy the rice.

The boy was very sad and disappointed. He realized that being proud is not always enough, and that sometimes it is important to follow the rules, even if it is not what we want to do.

The boy went home that day, feeling less proud and not with the bag of rice he had set out for. He knew that he would have to try another way to get the rice for his family.

Once upon a time there was a boy named Nathan. Nathan was three years old. He was always very helpful. 

One day, Nathan went for a walk in the park. He saw a beautiful blue bird! Nathan was so excited that he shouted "Hello bird!". 

The bird flew away but came back with a surprise. It had found a blue feather for Nathan! 

Nathan shouted "Thank you" to the bird. He was very thankful for the helpful bird. He held the blue feather close to his heart and went home to show his friends. 

The end.

One day, the boy was busy playing with his toys. He was having so much fun that he didn't want to leave. Suddenly he found something very unusual on the floor beside him. It looked like a big yellow lemon. He quickly picked it up and wanted to know what it was. 

He asked his mom, and she told him it was a lemon. He asked why it was in his room, and she said it had been left behind by the grocery store delivery man. 

The boy thought it was fascinating, and started to play with the lemon. He held it in his hands, squeezed it, and smelled it carefully. After a while, he decided to make a lemonade. He asked his mom for help, and together they made the most delicious lemonade ever. 

After seeing him so busy, his mom decided it was time for him to take a break. She told him to leave the lemon and take a nap. The boy did as he was told, and went to take a nap. 

When he woke up, he was happy to find that the lemon was still there. He had a great time playing with it - and drinking the lemonade he and his mom made - and was happy he could leave the lemon there for their next adventure.

Once, there was a boy named Jack and he loved to go on adventures. He decided to take a walk outside to see what he could find. He stepped on the grass and found a piece of cloth with different colors and shapes on it. 

Jack was very excited to find this cloth. He asked his mom what it was and she told him it was a quilt. Jack asked his mom if he could take it home, and she said yes. 

Back home, Jack wanted to show his friends the quilt. He stepped into his room where his friends were waiting for him. 

When Jackâ€™s friends saw the quilt, they were excited. Each of them wanted to touch it because it was so different from any other cloth they had ever seen. 

All of his friends were happy because Jack found something special. They all agreed that his quilt was the most interesting thing Jack has ever brought home.

Once upon a time there was a gray mouse. The mouse really wanted to stay in his cozy hole, but he just couldn't stay there forever. He wanted to explore the world! 

The mouse asked his mom if he could go outside. She said "yes, but only if you promise to come back in a few hours." She gave him a permit to go out and explore.

The mouse was thrilled. He had never been allowed to go outside by himself before. He walked and walked, and saw so many interesting things. But he always remembered the promise he had made to his mom, so he eventually came back home.

His mom was very happy to see him back safe and sound. She said "My brave little mouse! You were allowed out today but always remember to abide by my rules and get a permit before you go exploring again!â€ The mouse nodded and snuggled into his cozy hole to stay.

Once upon a time there there was a fierce big cat called Max. He liked to take long walks in the wide forest near his home. One day, Max came across a lake. He stopped and looked around, but he couldn't see anything special. Suddenly, a voice came from the lake.

â€œMax, come here,â€ the voice said.

Max was scared and wanted to leave but he was curious, so he stepped closer. Then, he saw another fierce big cat come out of the lake. The cat said, â€œI am Ty the Water Cat. I live underwater. Come with me, Max.â€

Max didn't know what to do. He was not sure if he should take Ty's advice or not.

He thought for a moment and then he decided to take Ty's advice. He followed him into the lake.

Max was amazed by what he saw. There were lots of colourful fishes, coral reefs, and wonderful underwater plants. Ty showed Max all the amazing underwater things. It was a beautiful place, and Max had a great time.

At the end of the day, Ty said goodbye to Max and Max said goodbye. He took the long journey home with a big smile on his face. From then on, Max visited Ty in the wide lake every week.

Once upon a time there was a big yellow boat that lived in the lake. The boat was old and needed to be fixed. So Papa and Maple, the little three-year-old girl, set out to restore the boat.

Maple asked, "What are we doing, Papa?"

Papa looked up from the boat and said, "We are restoring the boat, Maple. We need to make it look new again."

Maple nodded and said, "Yes! It will look so pretty!"

Papa warned Maple to be careful, for the lake was dangerous. Maple said, "Okay Papa, I will be careful."

So Papa and Maple worked together to restore the boat. They cleaned it, painted it and even placed a rainbow flag at the top! When they were finished, they looked at the little yellow boat with pride.

"It looks so pretty now, Papa!" Maple said.

"Yes, it does," Papa replied with a smile.

And from that day on, the little yellow boat in the lake was safe and restored.

Once upon a time there was a little bunny called Chloe. Chloe was so excited because today she was going to have a nap. She took off down the garden path and hopped until she reached a beautiful tree. She saw a big, soft bed of grass and snuggled into it.

Just as Chloe was settling down, she heard a loud shock. She knew it wasn't thunder and it scared her. She opened her eyes and saw a big loud monster. Chloe looked so scared and sad.

The monster said, "Why did you come here? I was just about to have a nap! You ruined my nap, so now you have to leave". Chloe was so sad. She didn't want to lose her nap, so she said, "I'm sorry. I will leave".

The monster stopped for a minute and looked at Chloe. He said, "No, you can stay and have a nap. I will go and find somewhere else to sleep. Goodbye Chloe!"

So Chloe had a nice nap under the big tree, and never saw the monster again. The end.

John wanted to draw a picture, so he told his mom he needed some paper. She handed him a big piece of white paper, and he sat down to draw. Suddenly, a gorilla appeared in the window! It had an ugly face and was scowling. 

John was scared and started to cry. His mom quickly wiped away his tears and told him not to worry. She said she would get rid of the gorilla. She grabbed a broom from the kitchen, held it high above her head, and chased the gorilla away. 

John felt safe and smiled. He thanked his mom and quickly went back to his drawing. He knew that his mom would always protect him and keep him safe.

Once upon a time, there was a girl. She was very careless and liked to have fun. One day, she went outside and decided to jump in a big puddle. She splashed and made big waves around her. But, when she looked down, she noticed her hands were all muddy. She remembered her mom had said to mind the dirt, so she knew she had to clean her hands.

The girl went inside and her mom gave her some soap. She put it on her hands and started to rub them together. The soap foamed and she enjoyed feeling it tickle her palms. After she finished, she could see her hands were all clean and shiny again.

The girl was happy and didn't want to be careless again. Whenever she went outside and got her hands a bit dirty, she always made sure to mind the dirt and wash them with soap.

Once upon a time, there was a little fox who was very tired, so he decided to take a nap. He scurried off to the cave where he thought it was the best place to sleep. Once the fox arrived, he sat down and closed his eyes, letting out a big yawn. 

He was just starting to drift off when he heard a deep rumble. In fear, he quickly opened his eyes and saw that it was a friendly bear. The bear was licking his lips and looking very hungry.

The bear asked the fox, â€œHave you seen something delicious? I am starving.â€ The fox thought of his lunch that was packed in his pocket. He knew that it was important to be kind, so he decided to share with the bear. The fox offered his lunch to the bear and the bear gratefully accepted.

The fox and the bear ate together. The bear thanked the fox for being so kind and invited him to explore the cave. The fox was excited to explore the cave but he needed to stay alert, so he took a few moments to wake up. He stretched and yawned, feeling very refreshed.

The fox and the bear had lots of fun exploring and the fox learnt a valuable lesson, that kindness makes the world a better place. The fox was thankful for the delicious meal and the moment he shared with the bear.

Once upon a time there was a boy who loved to wave. He waved to the sun, he waved to the birdies and he waved to his mommy and daddy. One day he wanted to be even better at waving. So, he went to the garden to practice.

The boy waved his arms all around. He waved them high and low. He waved them to the left and he waved them to the right. He became very competitive.

After a while he got tired. He reached up as high as he could and thenâ€¦ he fell down. There were lots of yummy leaves all around and he had a lot of fun. But then it became time to go home. 

The boy said goodbye to the leaves and he waved again. He waved to the sky, the trees and his mommy and daddy. As he got ready to go home, he smiled because he knew he was the best waver in town.

One day there was a modern car. It was bright green and had lots of buttons. The car belonged to a little boy. He loved to play with the buttons on the car. 

One day the boy pushed the red button. Suddenly the car started to move. The boy was so excited. 

The car drove down the road until it stopped at an ice cream shop. The boy got out of the car and ran inside. He bought a delicious strawberry ice cream cone. 

When he finished eating, the boy got back into the car. He pushed the blue button and the car started to drive. The car drove the boy back home. 

When the car stopped, the boy got out and said goodbye. The modern car made a noise and the boy's day ended.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She was walking in the woods when she saw something in the trees. It was a twig that appeared clear as ice.

The little girl was curious, so she asked her mom, "What is that twig?".

Her mom smiled and said, "That's a magical twig. It is clear and sparkly, and it makes wishes come true!" 

The little girl was so excited! She wanted a wish to come true. She reached for the twig, but it disappeared. 

The mom smiled and said, "The twig is magical. It only appears when it's ready to give a wish." 

The little girl was happy to know that, so she waited. She believed that soon the twig would appear, and her wish would come true.

Once upon a time there was an old store. It was very dark inside the store, but suddenly something magical happened. A big light started to glow. It shone very brightly and lit up the store. 

The glow made the store look more beautiful and interesting. Lots of people stopped to admire the bright light. 

One of those people was a little 3 year old girl. She thought the store was very exciting because of the glow. She watched it dance around and light up all the old things in the store.

The girl laughed with delight as the light made the store look special and new. Soon she started to glow too, just as brightly as the store's light. 

The little girl was filled with joy, and she enjoyed watching the glow until it was time to go home.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Bella. Every day she would wake up and be so excited to start the day.

One day, Bella woke up a bit grumpy. She rubbed her eyes and got out of bed. She looked around and saw something strange. There was a big mark on her wall!

Bella asked her mom, "What is that mark?" Her mom smiled and answered, "That's a special mark that was made by a very special guest."

Bella was so curious. She went to look at it up close. "It looks like a butterfly!" Bella said, her face lighting up.

But then she noticed something else. The mark was fading. "Why is it fading?" she asked.

Her mom replied, "That means our special guest is about to leave. Soon he'll be waking up and flying away."

Bella was so sad to say goodbye, but she knew that her grumpy morning was turning into a magical day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She loved to dream. She would imagine what the world would look like with more jam. She thought everything would taste sweeter and there would be lots of nice things to make from the sticky stuff.

One day, something bad happened. The little girl had made a big mess with the jam. Everywhere was a sticky, sweet mess. She was very sorry for it.

Her dad came and saw the mess. He said he was not mad. He said it was okay to make a mistake but to always remember to be careful.

The little girl wanted to show her dad she had learned the lesson. She thought really hard and washed all the jam away. Her dad smiled and said he was proud of her.

The moral of the story is that it is OK to make mistakes, but always remember to be careful and learn from them.

Once upon a time there was a purple dog. It was the most beautiful dog ever. Everywhere the dog went people stopped to admire the pup. One day the dog had an idea. He wanted to borrow some ash from a neighbor. So the dog trotted over to the neighbor's door and knocked. The neighbor was not happy to see the dog but let him in anyway. The dog asked for some ash, but the neighbor said no. The dog begged, but the neighbor said no again - so the dog left without any ash.

Days went by, and the dog continued to be admired. One day, the purple pup was walking along a path when he spotted the ash from the neighbor. It was small piles of ash all over the ground. The dog quickly realized the neighbor had been trying to protect the ash by keeping it away from the pup. He was happy to have finally found the ash he had been searching for. 

The dog used the ash to look even better. Everywhere he went, people stopped and said he was the most beautiful pup in the land. The dog was very proud of his finds and the purple ash that made him look even more beautiful.

Jim was sad. He wanted to play with his friends but they had all gone. Jim thought of a plan - he would make a promise. He would put the promise in a box and save it for his friends when they returned. 

He all made the promise. He put it in the box and locked it. He hoped his friends would remember it when they came back. 

But soon after that bad things started happening. The box got bigger and bigger, and soon it was bigger than Jim. He couldn't open it because it had grown so big. 

One day the box began to shake and rumble. Jim knew it was too late, he had made the wrong promise. It was a sad ending.

Once there was a little lion who lived in a large jungle. He had thick and fluffy fur, but he was always feeling very alone. He looked around the jungle, and couldn't find any other lions, so he decided to roar to make some friends.

The jungle filled with his fierce, scary roar. He looked around, but no friends came to play with him. All of a sudden, he heard something else roar back. He ran and followed the sound to discover a big fountain in the middle of the jungle.

Beside the fountain he saw two other lions. They were very friendly and made him feel less alone. The little lion was so excited he jumped, and sprayed a fountain of water around them all. The three lions laughed and laughed, playing together all day.

At the end of the day, the little lion felt so happy that he had made some new friends. He said goodbye to the two lion friends, and they all roared together one last time. The little lion then happily ran off home, feeling less alone in the thick jungle.

Once upon a time, there was a little tree. It was very young, but it liked to grow. So every day, it would try to get bigger.

One day, though, something bad happened. A mean, ignorant person chopped the little tree into a bunch of pieces. The little tree was so sad and angry!

But then something wonderful happened. The pieces of the little tree started to grow! Even though it was chopped into pieces, it was still able to grow.

Eventually, the pieces grew into a big and beautiful tree. The tree was even bigger than it used to be!

At the end, the little tree taught everyone an important lesson: you should never give up, no matter how ignorant someone is.

Once upon a time, there was a kind and curious little girl called Rose. She lived in a small cottage in the middle of a dark and mysterious forest. Rose was always asking her parents lots of questions. One day, she asked them what lay beyond the forest. Her parents told her that beyond the forest was a beautiful beach with crystal clear waters. 

The next morning, full of excitement, Rose packed some lunch and set out on an adventure. As she wandered through the forest, she noticed the ground getting wetter and the air becoming very smelly. Soon she noticed that instead of the beach, she'd found a big bog.

Rose was so disappointed. But, she was determined to not lose her sense of adventure. She decided to take a closer look, so she stepped closer to the bog. Suddenly, Rose heard a voice calling out to her, â€œHelp me!â€.

It was a small animal that had become trapped in the bog. Rose thought and thought about what to do. She eventually decided to reply to the animal, â€œI am here to help you!â€. 

Rose then used some nearby sticks to slowly pull the animal out of the bog. The animal thanked Rose for her kind and courageous act. 

The moral of the story is: a kind heart and courageous spirit will always help you find a way out of any difficult situation.

Jane was very tired. She wanted to take a nap. She asked her mom, "Will you take me to the cliff to sleep?" Her mom smiled and said, "Yes of course!"

When they arrived at the cliff, Jane looked out at the beautiful view. It was so fair. Jane was so excited. She hugged her mom and said, "Thank you for taking me here!"

They lay down together on the grass. The sun was setting in the sky. Jane started to feel sleepy. Her mom said, "We should go to sleep now. The night is coming."

So, Jane and her mom closed their eyes and fell asleep at the cliff. Jane dreamed of the beautiful fair view from the cliff and of running through the grass. When Jane's mom woke up, she carried Jane back home feeling happy.

Jane was a poor little girl. Her family did not have much money and her old home was quite small. She lived with her mom and dad in one room. 

One day, Jane saw that the window in their room was open. She was excited and ran over, wanting to see what was outside. When Jane saw the street below, she decided to slide down the window. 

Her mom shouted at her to stop, but Jane would not listen. She kept going further and further down the window. Her mom was so worried because Jane was going to get hurt. 

Suddenly, her dad's strong hands pulled Jane up from the window! He explained that she could not do this because it was so dangerous. Poor Jane had to stay inside the room but she promised to not slide down the window ever again.

Once upon a time there lived a little girl called Sally. She was three years old and loved to play with her toys. One day, her parents bought her an amazing piano. She was so excited and couldn't wait to learn how to play it. 

Sally's mum said to her, "Sally, you can learn how to play this piano if you believe in yourself". But Sally didn't know what that meant. She asked her mum, "Mum, what does it mean to believe?".

Her mum happily replied, "It means to trust in yourself that you can do something and believe that you can achieve it". Sally nodded and hugged her mum. She was so happy! She was determined to learn how to play the piano, no matter what.

The next day, Sally practised hard. She learnt the scales and chords quickly, and soon she was able to play an amazing song. Her parents were so proud of her and gave her a big hug and a kiss.

Sally had learnt that with belief in yourself and a bit of hard work, you can achieve anything. And it was all thanks to her amazing piano!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Mary. Mary was very happy and always wanted to play.

Today, Mary had a great time playing with her toys. Until she heard a loud sound. It was so hot that Mary felt scared. She began to cry and was very upset. 

Mary looked out the window and saw a huge wave coming closer and closer. Mary tried to close the windows but it was too late. She was hit by the waves and wet all over. She was so cold and upset.

The wave went back out but Mary was never the same. She couldn't stop shaking and feeling very scared. She was so sad and scared that she never wanted to play again. 

The bad wave changed Mary forever.

Once upon a time there was an oyster. The oyster was gray and it lived in the ocean. Every day the oyster moved around the ocean, looking for food. One day the oyster moved into a really sunny part of the ocean. The oyster loved the sunshine and it moved around in the sun, feeling happy and warm. Then suddenly, a big wave came and moved the oyster away. The wave moved the oyster to a different part of the ocean. The oyster was sad without the sun, but it kept on moving around and looking for food. The oyster kept moving until it finally found another sunny place to stay in. The oyster was so happy, and it moved around in the sunny part of the ocean, feeling wonderful. The End.

There once was a very big zoo. In the zoo, there were many animals and birds. One day, two children, John and Jane, went to the zoo. 

John was only three, but he was very brave. He followed Jane down a path and eventually they came to a big elephant. John was amazed.

Jane smiled at John and said, "Do you want to pet it?"

John nodded and with a trembling hand, he put his hand on the elephant's trunk. It was very soft and the elephant made a happy noise. John's face lit up with joy.

John and Jane continued their trip down the path. Everywhere John went, he was in awe of what he saw! At the end of their trip, the two of them had seen the biggest animals they had ever seen!

Once upon a time in a land far away, there lived a young girl. Her name was Sarah and everyday she would wake up in her beautiful bedroom. She would look out the window and see bright birds, green trees and blue sky. One morning, Sarah woke up and decided she wanted to explore the world. 

So, she put on her shoes and went outside. As she walked, she saw different things like tall buildings, little animals and nice people. She said hi to them all and waved. 

She came to a big field with a river through the middle of it. Sarah lay down and looked up. The sky was so blue and the clouds so white. She saw them move and change shapes.

Suddenly she noticed a little baby rabbit near her. Sarah smiled and the rabbit hopped away. She followed the baby rabbit and saw something even more beautiful. A big garden of many colours - green, pink, yellow, orange and purple. 

The young girl was in awe and said, "This place is so beautiful". She spent the rest of the day playing and discovering the world around her. At night, she went back home, dreaming of all the beautiful things she'd seen.

Jack was walking through the hallway. He saw an enormous mess! Everywhere he looked there was something spilled on the floor. Jack knew he couldn't leave the mess there, he needed to clean it.

He went to the closet and grabbed a mop. The mop was too big for Jack but he needed it to clean the mess. He tried to lift it but it was so heavy he couldn't carry it.

Then his big brother came by and saw the mess. He said he would help and grabbed the enormous mop. He started to mop the floor and it didn't take long before the hallway was clean! Both Jack and his brother were very happy.

Once, there was a girl called Emily. She was three years old and loved to explore. One day, she spotted a cave in the woods and went inside. As she crawled into the small and uncomfortable cave, she found that there were lots of animals inside. 

She wanted to take them home, so she put them all in a bag. After she had filled the bag, she went outside the cave. 

Suddenly, she heard a loud voice: "What have you got there?" It was the owner of the cave, an old man. He shouted, "You are not allowed to take my animals away!"

Emily was frightened, but she pleaded with the old man, "Please, let me keep them! I promise I will take good care of them."
The old man refused, and Emily had to leave the bag of animals. 

Sad and upset, Emily had to go home empty-handed and received nothing for her efforts.

Mia was playing in the garden with a sparkly diamond. She spun it around and around, watching all the colors glow in the sun. She loved how bright and beautiful the diamond was. She thought it was the most special thing ever.

Then, Mia had an idea. She wanted to create something wonderful with her diamond. She thought and thought, until she figured it out. She put her diamond in the soil and planted a flower. She watered it every day and waited for the surprise it would bring.

At first, nothing seemed to happen. Mia was sad, but then one day something wonderful happened - the flower began to grow! And the flower was different than any other flower she had seen before. It was a special, rare flower whose petals looked like diamonds.

Mia was so lucky and excited. She had created a beautiful diamond flower. She couldn't believe it. She had created something so special and unique with only a small diamond. Mia couldn't wait to show her friends what she had accomplished. She was so proud of herself.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Daisy. Daisy was so excited because she heard about a special game. She heard that whoever won the game would get a hut all for themselves.

So, Daisy got ready and started the game. She was really concentrating on it and working hard to win. After a while, Daisy did it! She had won the game!

Now that Daisy had won, she was given a key to open the hut which was behind the trees. Daisy ran to the hut but it looked very strange. It was full of crazy shapes and colours.

Inside the hut, Daisy discovered lots of fun things to do. She could jump, swing, and spin until she was so dizzy. Daisy loved her hut and she plays in it all day.

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a young boy named John. He was very gifted, and had lots of toys. One day, he spotted a big ship sailing near his house. He was so excited to get on board!

John asked his mom if he could go on the ship, but she said no. "It's too dangerous, sweetheart," she said. So, John made a plan to steal the ship and sail away.

He packed a bag of food and some clothes and sneaked onto the ship. As he was sailing away, John shouted, "I'm taking this ship on a journey!"

Suddenly, he saw the ship's captain, who yelled, "Oh no! You can't take this ship!" John was very scared and he started to cry.

The captain was very kind and said, "It's ok. I understand why you wanted to steal the ship. You can stay on board and help me sail this ship!"

John was really happy and agreed to stay. From then on, he and the captain started having many great adventures together!

Once upon a time there was a family who lived by the sea. Every day they would take long walks by the shore and listen to the waves.
One day, the family decided to make a picnic by the sea. They made rice, salad and a spicy sauce. Everyone loved the sauce, especially the little girl. 
She ate it all up and insisted she wanted more. Her dad went to make the same sauce, but he just couldn't get the same taste. The little girl insisted that they go to the sea to get more of the spicy seasoning. 
So they followed the little girl and went searching for the spice. When they got to the sea, they didn't find any spices. Instead, they found a giant seahorse!
The seahorse asked for help as he had lost his way. The family agreed to help him and as a reward for their kindness, the seahorse gifted them a spicy sprinkle that tasted just like the one from the picnic. The little girl was very happy and ran back to the picnic. 
Everybody enjoyed the spicy sprinkle from the sea. 
The End.

One day, a little boy was walking down the street when he saw a pond. He wanted to have some fun, so he started to splash in the water. The splashing was so much fun that the boy felt like he had magical powers. He felt so good with these magical powers that he jumped in the water and started to swim. He kept on splashing until he was so tired. But he still felt so good that he stayed in the pond for a while longer. Finally, he was ready to go home. He was so happy that he had made his own magical moment by splashing in the pond.

Once upon a time, Jack was playing in the park. Suddenly â€“ something mysterious caught Jack's eye. It was a mask! Jack thought it looked cool and picked it up. He put it on and it fit perfectly. 

Jack really liked it and he decided to take it home. When he got home, he showed his mom the mysterious mask. His mom said he could keep it, as long as he took good care of it.

Jack put the mask on every single day. He loved playing with it. One day, while playing outside, he left the mask in the grass. He started to look for it, but it had disappeared! He was so worried and started crying.

But then, Jack remembered something his mom had said. She said that when he loses something, he should always look for it later in the same place - and just like that, the mask reappeared! Jack was so happy that he hugged it tight.

The end.

Once upon a time there was a furry little puppy called Riley. He was always full of energy and dreamt of flying. One day, Riley saw a bird soaring through the sky and realised it was his dream. He knew that if he tried hard enough he could make his dream come true.

So each day, Riley spent hours practising jumping higher and higher. After a few weeks, he was able to jump even higher than the bird! But then something terrible happened - Riley jumped too high and crashed into a big tree.

Riley was very sad and soon realised that he would never be able to make his dream come true. All of his hard work had been for nothing. Riley was never able to fly and his dream was always just out of reach.

Once upon a time, there were two friends. One was rich and the other wasn't. One day, they decided to have a race. The rich one had a triangle and the other one had a long stick. They both put their objects on the floor, ready to race.

"Ready, set, go!" shouted the rich friend. Both of them started to speed across the room. The triangle whizzed faster than the other one, because it was so light. The rich friend won the race, but it was fun for both of them.

When they finished, the poor friend said, "That was fun! But I think I'll stick to using my stick from now on!" The rich friend replied, "That's a good idea!"

The two friends laughed and enjoyed the race. It was a fun time for both of them. They enjoyed playing together and running as fast as they could!

One day, a young girl named Betty wanted to go explore outside. She put on her shoes, grabbed her favorite teddy bear, and set off to find something exciting. 

Betty walked and walked until she stumbled upon an unusual stone. It was big, round, and sparkly. She had never seen a stone like this before! She decided to stay with the stone and see what it did.

Betty spent the whole day playing with the stone. She threw it in the air, put it in her pocket, and even gave it a hug. Then the sun began to go down and it was time to go home. 

Betty said goodbye to the stone and ran to her house. From that day on, she always stayed near the unusual stone whenever she went exploring - because it was her special friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named John. He was very keen to win a prize. One day, he saw a big contest was being held to win a big, shiny prize. He was so excited and he wanted to enter! He started to zip around and around, trying to get to the contest in time. 

But when he reached the contest, he saw it was really dull. All the other entries were plain and boring, and he was the only one who was zipping around. He was disappointed and felt that he didn't stand a chance of winning, but he still decided to compete. 

At the end of the day, John found out he had won the big, shiny prize! Everyone around him was so surprised and happy, because he was the only one who was different. 

This story teaches us that it is important to be unique and not be afraid to stand out. Being different makes you special and it can help you win prizes if you never give up!

Once there was a hungry bunny. He was hopping through the woods in search of something to eat. Suddenly, he stopped. He sniffed the air with his nose. What was that delicious smell?

The bunny hopped through some bushes and discovered a patch of juicy carrots! He munched on a few of the carrots and felt very happy. He hopped around the carrots and found more surprises.

The bunny discovered a juicy apple and he hopped around it, excitedly. He was so happy and so hungry, he ate the apple in a few bites. Yum!

After that, he hopped a little further. He sniffed the air with his nose and discovered a big, juicy strawberry! He hopped over to it and with one bite, he slurped it all up.

It was a great day for the hungry bunny. He had discovered lots of tasty treats and was very full. He hopped away, feeling happy and content.

Tommy wanted to help his mum. She had lots of bags to carry, and so he tried to pick one up. It was too heavy, even though he tried very hard to carry it.

Mum saw how much he wanted to help, so she said he could help her by giving her a shoulder to lean on. He was so excited! He ran over with a big smile, and he helped mum with her bags.

They went for a walk together and stopped beneath a big green tree. Mum said it was a nice spot to take a rest. They both sat down and had a snack and some drinks. Suddenly the sun went behind a cloud and everything became cold. So Tommy helped his mum to get up, and they went for a walk again.

As they walked, Tommy's mum looked down and said "Thank you for helping me. I am very happy that you are here with me." Tommy was relieved, and smiled very wide. The sun came out from behind the clouds and they enjoyed the bright green trees and flowers in the garden. 

Tommy was very happy he had been able to help his mum. He had been able to give her a shoulder to lean on, and she was very grateful. That made him feel amazing.

Once upon a time there was a girl who went on a wild adventure. She had a weird rag with her and it was her best friend. One day, she went deep into the forest and came across a strange creature. The creature was so weird that the girl was scared. The creature said, "Will you feed me?"

The girl was unsure what to do. She thought about the rag she had with her. She slowly took the rag out of her pocket and offered it to the creature. To her surprise, the creature was so happy! It said, "Thank you for feeding me", before it disappeared back into the forest.

The girl was glad she had her rag with her. From then on, she always kept it with her on all of her adventures. She learned that it's better to be kind to creatures, no matter how weird they may look!

Once upon a time, there lived a little girl named Clara. Clara was very curious. One day, she went for a walk in the park with her mom. As she walked around, Clara noticed something very special: a lot of colorful notes laid on the ground. 

Clara asked her mom what the notes were and her mother said, "These are called notes, and they are very special. We can collect them!"

Clara was very excited and she quickly started to collect the notes. But when she placed them in her pocket, she noticed that some of them were dirty. She asked her mother why the notes were dirty.

Her mother replied, "Sometimes, the wind can make things like this dirty. Don't worry, you can still collect them!"

Clara smiled, and quickly gathered all the notes she could find. When she was done, she had quite a big collection! She hugged her mom and said, "Thank you for helping me collect these!"

Sam had a plan to be successful. He decided to leave his house and find a maze. He thought that if he could find the maze, he could be successful. So, he packed his bag and set out on his adventure.

Sam searched and searched, but he couldn't find the maze. He was so tired from searching that he eventually lay down and rested. He wanted the maze to be close, but he couldn't find it.

Finally, he tried one last time and found the entrance to the maze. He started to walk through it, but the maze was too tricky and he got lost. He didn't know what to do and eventually gave up.

Sam sadly returned home without finding the maze. He wasn't successful because he couldn't find it. He was disappointed, but he still had his plan to try again and be successful.

Once upon a time there were two pupils who were very good friends. Every day, they celebrated by jumping and playing together in the sunshine. One day, the sky went pale and it started to rain. The two pupils were sad because they could no longer play together. 

However, when the sky cleared, the two pupils were so happy! The sky was no longer pale, but instead it was a brilliant blue. They celebrated by having a picnic while squinting in the sunshine. 

They chose a spot under a tree and opened their lunch boxes. They ate sandwiches, drank juice, and enjoyed their special picnic. After they ate their lunch, they tossed around a ball and ran up and down hills. 

They celebrated their friendship as they enjoyed the sunshine and played together. Even when the clouds come, they always have something to celebrate!

Once upon a time, there was a dancer named Sandy. She was a beautiful dancer and she loved to perform for her family and friends.

One day, Sandy got hurt and she was very upset. She had hurt her ankle and was worried she would never dance again.

Sandy's mother saw how distressed she was, so she decided to help. She put a bandage on Sandy's ankle and sang her a special healing song. She said, "Everyone gets hurt sometimes, but that doesn't mean you can't still dance. With a little time and patience, you will heal and be dancing again!" 

And that's exactly what happened. Sandy's ankle healed and she could dance again. She remembered the lesson her mom had taught her; that sometimes when life is tough, the best thing to do is to be patient and give it time. Eventually, you will heal and be better than before!

Lucy and Mom were in the desert. Lucy saw a cactus. It was bigger than her head! She wanted to climb it but Mom said no. Then Mom saw a strange tree. It had a rope attached to it.

Mom said â€œLetâ€™s swing!â€ Lucy was so excited! She grabbed the rope and started to swing high. She could feel the wind in her face and she felt so happy!

Mom pushed her higher and higher until Lucy was almost too scared. Then suddenly something happened. The rope in her hands started to move on its own! It was an unknown force that pushed the rope back and forth!

Lucy felt so scared but she still held onto the rope. She thought it was magic! After some time, Mom said it was time to go home. Lucy had a great time and she still felt like she was flying!

Once there was a girl called Katie. She was 3 years old. One day, she wanted to take a nice cross - it was bright and colourful, and she thought it was very pretty.

So, she went outside and found a cross. She took it and hugged it tight. She was very happy to have her own nice cross.

Katie took her cross to the garden and played with it. She made a game where she pretended to be an explorer looking for a hidden treasure. She pretended to take her nice cross with her on her adventure - just like all the brave explorers did.

Katie played for a long time until it was time to go back inside. She took her cross and hugged it one last time. She felt very happy and excited to keep playing the next day with her special cross.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Joe. He was three years old and he was always very happy.

One day, Joe wanted to go on a big adventure. He decided to take a trip to the tip. Joe was so excited, but he was a little worried too. He was scared that the trip might be a bit boring.

So Joe decided to ask his mum for help. His mum gave him a big bag full of fun toys and she showed him the best way to get to the tip.

When Joe arrived, he was delighted to see so many fun things. There were old toys to play with and piles of cards to make. Joe played there all day and forgot all about his worries. It was the best day of his life!

Once there was a little girl called Mandy. She had a wonderful model plane. Every day after school, she would take it out and throw it high into the sky. She loved to watch it soar up high, faster and faster. 

One day, Mandy was practising throwing her model plane, when suddenly she saw an eagle soaring in the sky. It was so beautiful, she decided she wanted to throw her plane higher so she could be like the eagle. 

But this time, her plane flew too high and too far away. Mandy began to worry. She searched everywhere, but the plane was gone. She was sad and upset. 

Suddenly, she heard a rustling sound in the nearby bushes. She looked over and saw her plane was safely perched on a branch. She was so relieved and quickly ran over to retrieve it. 

From then on, Mandy was very careful when throwing her model plane. She wanted to make sure it was safe and she never wanted to lose it again.

Once, there was a little girl who loved to play the flute. She would put on her pretty dress and run to the park, her favorite spot to perform.

One day, she was playing her flute, when she heard a strange noise. She saw a pale cat stuck in a bush. She quickly put down her flute and ran to rescue the cat.

The girl stuck her arm in the bush, and the cat jumped out, into her arms. She said to the cat, "Are you ok?" The cat purred and rubbed against her neck.

The little girl was so happy to have rescued the cat. She hugged the cat and thanked it for joining her for a flute performance in the park. The cat meowed and seemed to understand. From then on, the little girl was never alone when she went to play her flute in the park.

Once upon a time there was a cherry tree in a big field. One day, the tree was busy loading lots of big and juicy cherries. It was a mysterious sight to see! Everyone in the village wanted to get a cherry, but they were too high up the tree. 

The village men thought of a plan. They brought a ladder and tried to climb up the tree to get the cherries. But the ladder was too small and it didn't reach the cherries. 

Then a clever girl had an idea. She told the village men to get a long piece of string and tie it to the cherries. She then pulled the string until the cherries fell down from the tree. Everyone was so happy and the girl was very proud. 

The village men loaded all the cherries into a big basket and took them back to the village. Everyone had a wonderful time enjoying the delicious cherries. It was such a mysterious and wonderful day!

George was very excited. He was going to the park with his mom. He grabbed a key and skipped to the door. He wanted to open it on his own. He tried the key in the door, but it wouldn't turn. He tugged and tugged, but nothing happened. Suddenly, the key snapped! George was ashamed. He started to tear.

Mommy came over and said "It's ok, George. We can use my key instead." She put the broken key in her pocket. She hugged George and wiped away his tears.

George was still ashamed, but he felt better. Mommy opened the door with her key, and the two of them went to the park. They had a wonderful time playing games and eating ice cream. Before the day was over, George had forgotten all about the broken key.

Once there was an adorable little girl called Lizzie. She liked to perform different tricks and entertain her family. One day, her mom asked her to help with the chores in the kitchen. Lizzie was so excited and she ran to the dishwasher. 

Lizzie jumped into the dishwasher and began to perform there. She enjoyed dancing and singing in it. But accidentally, she pressed the wrong button and suddenly, the dishwasher started spinning really fast! Lizzie was so scared that she screamed for help. 

Her mom came running to the kitchen and quickly stopped the machine. She pulled out an exhausted and dizzy Lizzie. Thankfully, Lizzie was alright, but sad because she had not finished her performance. 

The end.

Once there was a brave frog. He was looking for a home. He hopped and hopped for days. Suddenly, he came to a big swamp. He felt lonely, but he decided to explore it. 

As he hopped around, he saw something strange. Something seemed to happen in the middle of the swamp. He was curious. He hopped closer and saw a big orange snake. The snake seemed angry. 

The frog was scared, but he wanted to find out what was happening. He hopped closer and saw a pond nearby. That's when he noticed a small blue frog. It was in the water and the orange snake was trying to get it. 

The brave frog knew he had to help the little blue frog. He jumped right into the pond. The snake was taken by surprise and quickly left. The small blue frog thanked the brave frog.

The brave frog now had a new home, and he wasn't lonely anymore. He had a new friend in the swamp. Together they hopped around and explored the swamp. They made sure the orange snake never returned.

Once there was a girl named Mabel. She was only three years old and loved playing with her friends.

One day, Mabel went to the store with her mom. Inside, her mom bought a carton of oats for breakfast. But on the way home, Mabel got very nervous. She forgot to bring the oats.

So Mabel went back to the store. She asked her mom to help her find the oats. And when they found the oats, they both hugged each other.

Mabel was so happy! She never wanted to forget the oats again. And so, she made sure to always remember them, each time they went shopping.

Mary and her mom were in the kitchen for dinner. Mary had a napkin in her hand and she dangled it in the air.

"What are you doing, Mary?" her mom asked, smiling.

Mary grinned and replied, "I'm playing with the napkin."

"Oh, let me see!" her mom said.

Mary handed the napkin to her mom and she hung it on her finger. It looked funny hanging there.

"It looks like a hairy little monster!" her mom laughed.

They both laughed and hugged each other. Mary hugged the napkin and hung it on her finger again. She giggled when she pretended it was talking. Mary and her mom were having so much fun together.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who loved to explore. One day she found a bookshelf and wanted to find out what was inside. Her parents had warned her not to investigate bookshelves alone, but she decided to delay and open it anyways. When she got close, she noticed that the bookshelf was very dangerous. She found herself trapped and realized it was too late - she couldn't get out. From then on, the little girl always listened to her parents and never delayed doing the things they said.

Once upon a time there was a boy called Jake. He was three years old and could not wait to play with his friends. On that day, Jake went to the park. He brought his ball and his scooter. 

When Jake got there, he saw three other kids playing jazz. Jake wanted to join in and asked if he could play too. The other kids were a little rude and said, "No, this is our game". 

Jake did not know what to do, so he decided to just sit down and watch. But as he was sitting, his ball slipped out of his hands. It rolled over to the kids playing jazz. 

The kids stopped and were surprised. They asked Jake if he wanted to join them. As the day went on, Jake got better and better at playing jazz with his new friends. He had a really fun day. In the end, Jake was really happy he did not stay home.

Once there was a wealthy family with three kids. Two of them were in university, but the youngest one was only three. He wanted to go to university too!

One day, the three university students decided to take the youngest one with them on a fun day out. As they drove to the university, the little kid cheered with joy. 

When they arrived, the little kid wanted to explore everywhere. He ran around and screamed with excitement!

The university students showed him all the places and got him some ice cream. He was having so much fun!

At the end of the day, the family drove home and the little kid felt so happy. He dreamed of one day going to university too.

Once upon a time, there was a farmer who planted some seeds in the soil, hoping for a good crop. But the sun was too hot and the soil was too dry, so the farmer's crop was not very good.

The farmer was sad and didn't know what to do, so he made a fake seed. He hoped that it would help his crop to grow, but it didn't work. In the end all the seeds he planted turned out to be fake and the crop was ruined.

The farmer was very sad and knew that he had made a mistake by planting fake seeds. He wished he had planted real ones in the soil, but it was too late now. 

The farmer had to accept that there were no crops and he hoped he would never make the same mistake again.

One day, Mama took her little boy to the park. He felt so glad! Everywhere he looked he saw so many things to explore. He played on the swings and ran around the grass.

When he got tired, Mama brought out a special lunch for him. It was delicious! He ate it all up and was so content.

Before they left, Mama took her boy for a special shower. The water was warm and it felt so nice. He played and splashed and was so happy.

Finally, after he was fed and washed, they said goodbye to the park. Mama was glad she had such a fun day with her little boy. He smiled and held her hand as they walked home.

The sun was shining on the beautiful lake. A family was out for a picnic. They laughed and played together and it was a perfect day.

The little boy was so excited. He wanted to explore the lake. So he asked his dad if he could get in and go for a swim. His dad said yes, so he splashed into the water.

The water was so cool and the little boy was having so much fun. He paddled and floated around, exploring the lake.

After some time, the little boy became very tired, so he decided to get out of the lake. All of a sudden, he was surprised to find his dad had brought a boat and he knew just what his dad had planned. They set off in the boat, moving slowly and peacefully across the lake, soaking in its beautiful surroundings.

The family sailed around the lake until the sun began to set and the stars came out. It was a perfect way to end their adventure.

Once there was a little boy who wanted to go on a wild adventure. So he asked his mom, "Can I please go out into the wild?"

His mom said, "Yes, you may go, but be careful!" So the little boy set off into the wild world and he saw so many wonderful animals. 

He walked and walked until he came to a clearing where there was a wild animal. The animal was a big and hairy boar. He was very hungry and the little boy asked, "Will you give me some of your meat?" 

The boar said, "Yes, I shall leave some of my wild meat for you." So the little boy was very happy and picked up the wild meat off the ground. 

He continued his journey, happy to have found a piece of wild meat on his wild journey.

Once upon a time, there were two twins called Tim and Tom. They loved to play together in the park. One day, they were running around and playing tag. Suddenly, Tim pointed to a big red trampoline and shouted, "Let's jump!".

Tom and Tim both ran over to the trampoline. They jumped and jumped and jumped. Tom jumped high and long. Tim jumped lower and shorter. The twins laughed and shouted happily as they jumped around. 

They jumped in the air and around on the trampoline. Soon, they were jumping and jumping so much, they were both out of breath. Tom and Tim said goodbye and each went home. They were both so happy and they were looking forward to their next visit to the big red trampoline.

Once upon a time there was a modern pit. All the animals hated it. One day a rabbit said to a fox, â€œWe should do something about this awful pit.â€

The fox replied, â€œWhat can we do? Weâ€™re too little and the pit is too big.â€

The rabbit thought for a moment. Then he said, â€œLetâ€™s get the other animals together and see if we can push it away.â€

The fox smiled. â€œI like that idea. Iâ€™ll get everyone together.â€

The fox ran to the other animals and told them the plan. They were all excited to help out. So they all pushed on the pit. After a lot of hard work, they moved the modern pit away from their home.

Everyone cheered. The animals were so happy they never had to see that pit again. They all lived happily ever after. The End.

Once upon a time there was a poor boy. He was very tired and had no friends. He walked down the street, dragging his feet with every step and feeling sad. 

One day he saw a wink in the sky. The boy wondered what it was. He looked up and smiled.

"Maybe something good will happen to me," he said. 

He kept walking and walking, and soon he came upon an old man. The old man smiled at the boy and asked him if he wanted to come to his house. 

The boy followed the old man, but soon he started to feel very bad. He felt like he was not able to move and something was wrong. 

At last they reached the old man's house and the boy started to suffer. He screamed and tried to run away, but the old man had locked the door. 

The poor boy was never seen again. No one knew what happened to him and he was never freed. He suffers to this day and his exhausted body never gets any rest.

One day, two friends decided to go for an adventure. Toby the Toad was short and liked to hop, while Sol the Frog was green and enjoyed listening to the birds sing.

"Let's try to improve the pond," said Sol.

"That sounds unusual," smiled Toby.

So they both hopped over to the pond and began searching. After looking around, they found some unusual pieces of wood and a few stones. 

Toby said, "Let's put this wood and stones together to improve the pond."

So, under the watching eyes of the birds, Sol and Toby built a bridge over the pond. The bridge made the pond look much more unusual.

Toby said, "We've done an amazing job! Now, frogs can jump over the pond and have more fun."

Sol smiled and the two friends watched as a frog hopped across the bridge. It was an exciting improvement, and Toby and Sol were proud of their work.

Once there was a little boy. He loved to search! One day, he was searching and he heard a funny noise. He looked around, but he couldn't see what it was. He kept searching and then he found it! It was a big orange ball!

He picked it up and looked it all over. He saw that it was filled with water! He couldn't believe it! He wanted to show it to his mom. He held the orange ball tight, and ran off to show it to her.

When he arrived home, his mom was very surprised to see the orange ball full of water! They had lots of fun with it, and searched for more things around their house. They found lots of interesting things! The little boy was so happy.

Once there was a brave knight. He was traveling in a far away land when he saw a volcano. He was very curious, so he decided to explore it. He rode closer, and the ground began to shake. He looked around and saw thick smoke spewing out of the volcano. 

The brave knight was determined to explore it, so he got off his horse and began to climb. He was surprised to see that the volcano looked much bigger up close. He kept climbing, and finally reached the top. 

When he looked inside, his heart sank. He saw bubbling lava rising up and down. But before he could turn around and run, a giant dragon flew out of the volcano. 

The dragon glared at the brave knight. He could feel his courage weakening, but he still tried to fight it. He grabbed his sword, but the dragon just roared and nodded its head. The knight was filled with fear and he ran as fast as he could away from the volcano. He never looked back.

Once there was a little girl called Sally. Sally loved building things and playing in the garden. As the snow started to fall and the nights were getting dark and cold, Sally thought of the perfect way to spend her time. She got a box of her things and began to build a camp!

Sally used a blanket to make a roof and logs for the walls. She put a rug in the middle for the floor. She added some of her favourite things around the camp to make it cozy, like a pillow, a lamp and some pretty stones, too.

The camp was all finished now! Sally was so happy and it was so cozy in the camp that she invited her friends over to play. Even though it was cold outside, the camp was warm and everyone had a great time.

Sally learnt something that day - that you don't need much to build something amazing!

Once there was a playful little boy named Patrick. He loved to play games and go on adventures every day. One day he was playing tag with his friends in the park when suddenly the sky went dark and it started to rain. 

Patrick began to worry and said to his friends, "What shall we do now?" His friends replied, "Let's run home before we get too wet."

So they ran back to Patrick's house and when they got there they saw that the lights were on. His mom was in the kitchen making dinner. Patrick was so relieved that he ran up to her and hugged her. 

His mom said, "Surprise! I'm having a magical dinner for us tonight." Patrick was so excited that he could barely contain himself!

The dinner was delicious and afterwards the kids decided to go play a board game. Patrick wanted to play the game so badly that he accidentally knocked the pieces off the table. Everyone gasped but then his mom said, "It's okay Patrick, don't worry. We can set it up again." 

When the game was set up, Patrick started to play and he was so happy. Suddenly, something scary happened. A hand came out of the board game and it started to strike at Patrick. He screamed and backed up quickly. 

His mom said, "It's okay Patrick, it's just a nightmare. Nightmares can't hurt you." 

Patrick

Sam saw a big scale in the corner of the room. He was very excited and he had a lot of questions for his Mom.

"Mom, what is that?" inquired Sam.

"It's a scale," replied his Mom. "It weighs things."

Sam looked at the scale and said, "Can I try it? Can I weigh something?" 

"Sure, why not!" his Mom said with a smile.

Sam grabbed a rock from the floor and placed it on the scale. He carefully moved the weight around until it reached zero.

"Wow," said Sam with a huge smile. "It's so dull!" 

His Mom laughed and said, "Glad you had fun, Sam. Now let's find something else to do!"

Once there was a little boy named Ben. Ben liked shiny things, so when he saw a copper penny on the ground he ran over to get it. He liked the way the penny glinted in the sun.

But when Ben picked the penny up, he noticed a little ant underneath. The ant was trying hard to carry a small piece of food back to its nest. Ben knew the penny was too heavy for the ant, so he decided to help.

He knew the ant would not give up, so Ben insisted that he take the penny inside his house. He placed the penny in a special place in his room and promised to help the ant get its food back. He was determined and very persistent.

After several tries Ben was able to get the food to the ant's nest. The ant was very happy and thanked Ben for his kindness. Ben smiled and thanked the ant back. He was glad the ant was safe, and now he could keep the shiny copper penny that he found.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who had a new telephone. She loved it very much and carried it around everywhere. One day, she was so excited that she was running around and her telephone fell out of her pocket and she lost it. She cried and looked for it all over the place, but she just couldn't find it. She asked her mum to help her and then her mum called a new telephone for her.

The little girl was so happy to get the new telephone that she made sure to keep it safe with her this time. She kept it by her side all the time just to make sure she wouldn't lose it again. From that day onwards, she was careful to always keep her telephone safe.

Once there was a little girl named Jane. Jane had a special camera that she liked to take pictures with.

On hot summer days, Jane liked to take her camera and explore the park. She would look around and find interesting things to take pictures of. One day when she was looking around, Jane saw a family of ducks. She snapped some great photos of them with her camera!

As Jane continued exploring the park, she spotted a group of kids playing by a busy street. They all looked like they belonged together. She took a few pictures of the kids, but was careful not to get too close to the busy street.

When Jane got home, she showed her mom all the photos she had taken. Her mom was so proud of her for discovering interesting things, and taking amazing photos of them. 

They both had a lot of fun looking through the pictures, and remembering the fun day Jane had exploring the park!

Sam was a bald man. Every day he would put on his special jacket. The jacket was very important to Sam. It had lots of pockets, and in them was all the things he needed to record the day. He had a very special recording device that would help him remember everything he had seen and done during the day. 

Sam liked to take walks and look at the things around him. He would record the colors of the trees, the shapes of the clouds, the sound of the birds, and all sorts of other things. He was very curious and enjoyed recording the world.

Today, he went to the park to record things he hadn't seen before. He recorded the colors of the flowers, the speed of a squirrel running across the grass, and the sound of children playing. 

At the end of the day, Sam took off his special jacket and carefully put away his recording device. He smiled, happy to remember the things he had seen and heard. From now on, he would keep the recording in his memory and enjoy the world around him.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sarah. She was very brave, but sometimes she was a bit anxious. One day, Sarah decided to go to the theater. She had never been to a theater before, so she was extra anxious.

When Sarah arrived, she noticed that the theater was a bit cold. She began to shiver a bit. Suddenly, a kind theater worker saw Sarah. She gave Sarah a cozy blanket so she would not be cold. Even with the blanket, Sarah was still a bit afraid. But soon enough, Sarah's fear faded away and she was able to enjoy the show!

Once upon a time there was a bunny called Furry. Furry was very excited and couldn't wait to explore the forest. 

Furry hopped and hopped until he found a pond. He settled near the edge and started to drink the cool, clear water. Suddenly, Furry saw something oily floating on top of the water. He nibbled the oily thing and it tasted really bad. Furry felt sick and he went to settle on the grass to rest.

Unfortunately, the oil had made Furry very sick. As the hours went by, he felt worse and worse. Furry sadly passed away surrounded by the forest he had been so excited about exploring.

One day, a vendor went to the store to buy things. The store had different types of things inside, such as candy, toys, and books. The vendor was very excited to find something special. 
But, when the vendor went to the checkout line, they realized they didn't have enough money to pay for the things they wanted.

The vendor became very sad and decided to leave the store. On the way back, they passed by the park. There they saw many people playing, enjoying the sunshine. The vendor suddenly had an idea. 

They decided to pack up some of the things they had and sold them at the park. Everyone loved the different items, and the vendor soon made enough money to buy all they wanted from the store.

The moral of the story is that you don't need money to make money. Just be creative and resourceful, and you can find all sorts of different ways to make your dreams come true.

Once upon a time there was a little boy. His name was Timmy. He liked to paint. But one day, something terrible happened. He got red paint on his shirt and it got very filthy.

Timmy started to cry. He was really sad about his shirt. He wanted to know how he could fix it.

Finally, his mommy came and said, "It's ok, Timmy! I can help you. You will just need to feel a bit of pain and then your shirt will be better than before.

So his mommy carefully took the shirt off Timmy and washed it. Then she put a special cleaner on it and scrubbed it until it was good as new.

Once it was all clean, she put a new shirt on Timmy and he was so happy. He was so happy he ran around with a big smile on his face. He felt like he had just painted the world.

Once upon a time, there were two naughty kids. They loved to run and play near a big, tall structure in their backyard. One day, they decided to do something very naughty and climb the structure.

The kids reached the top of it and looked around. They could see far away, but at the same time, they felt scared. Suddenly, they heard a loud noise. They looked down and saw their mom coming! They quickly climbed down, one step at a time.

Time passed and the kids grew up. They started to regret not listening to their mom. They wished they had listened so they wouldn't have gotten in trouble. From then on, they stayed away from the tall structure and never climbed it again.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who wanted to travel. She looked up at the tall vine growing over her head and decided to climb it. She grabbed onto the vine and began to climb. As she got higher and higher, an old man noticed her and called out to her.

"Where are you going, child?" he asked. 

The little girl grinned. "Up!" she said and kept on climbing. 

The old man chuckled. "You can't reach the sky," he said. "But if you keep going, you'll reach the end of the vine."

So the little girl kept climbing and eventually reached the top of the tall vine. As she looked around, she felt so happy and proud of herself. She took in a deep breath of fresh air and said, "I did it! I traveled the tall vine!"

As she looked around, she knew it was time to go home. She carefully made her way back down the vine until she felt safe to jump down.

The old man was waiting for her with a smile on his face. "You travelled the tall vine bravely," he said.

She smiled and said, "Yep, I did it! It was so fun!" 

The old man said, "That's what adventure is all about. Keep exploring and never stop travelling!"

John was playing hockey in the park. He was whacking the puck around and having a lot of fun. But then he noticed it was getting gloomy outside, and he got a bit sad. He sighed and put away his hockey stick and skates, and went home.

John eventually forgot his sadness and he remembered the fun he had playing hockey. He smiled as he remembered what happened in the park and he was glad he was home.
